summary: Wheel/force-feedback value accessor. Dereferences this to obtain the owning object pointer, then reads and returns the dword at offset 0xF1C (3868) within that object. A trivial read-only accessor with no guards; called by sub_4BA1F0.

local_names.this: container object holding a pointer to the object that carries the force value

operations.description: Dereferences this to load the object pointer stored at this+0x0.
Reads the dword force/feedback value at obj+0xF1C (3868) from the dereferenced object.
Returns the read value to the caller.

unresolved: The type of the object reached through this+0x0 and the meaning of the 0xF1C value are not evidenced beyond the single read.
There is no null check on the dereferenced object pointer.
